procedure: Compare alert timestamps, affected identities and corroborating logs
expected_result: Incident scope and uncertainty are documented; suspected events are not labeled confirmed without support

procedure: Record evidence identifier, source, collector and hash
expected_result: Every collected item has timestamp, provenance and integrity reference

procedure: Review token/session revocation and scoped containment results
expected_result: No unexplained active sessions remain in the scoped review; business impact is recorded

procedure: Validate recovered identities against approved access and service checks
expected_result: Authorized access works; suspended access remains blocked; service checks pass

procedure: Review the agreed monitoring window and newly observed indicators
expected_result: New suspicious events are triaged and unresolved high-impact items block closure

procedure: Reconcile response actions and transfer remediation ownership
expected_result: Incident commander accepts residual risks and each follow-up has an accountable owner
